title: jsdelivr.net CDN poisoning for instantsearch.js@4.75.6
explanation: The issue report describes a technical problem with the instantsearch.js library, where the CDN link was potentially compromised and redirecting the user's page to an unrelated website. This suggests a frustrating and concerning situation for the user, who is a software developer and security researcher. The confusion and uncertainty around the root cause of the issue further contributes to the negative sentiment.
